moisture_convergence.note: Maximum local discrete-equation residual / max(rain+abs(evaporation),0.1 mm/day), full interior including spin-up.

label_policy_audit.note: Same model fields under two label policies; full-resolution map interpolation can differ.

solver.note: Sweep counts alone do not establish residual convergence; empty with direct solver.

temperature_convergence.note: Final fixed-point update, not a PDE residual. Includes spin-up.
